outputs.discrepancies: The caption lists the antibody combination as '138-129', but no antibody named '129' appears anywhere in the figure. The domain map (panel A) and the corresponding heatmap row in panel C only show antibodies '138' and '139' (i.e., '138-139'), not '138-129'. This is a naming mismatch between the caption text and the antibody actually depicted/labeled in the image.

The caption states that panel D shows 'log2 enrichment ratio (HTT IP vs mIgG IP)' for all four antibody groups (EPR5526, 2B7-4C9, 4E10-3E10, and D7F7). However, in the image the left three violin plots are labeled 'Abundance vs. mIgG (Log2)', while the D7F7 violin plot is labeled 'Abundance vs. rIgG (Log2)', i.e., a rabbit IgG (not mouse IgG) control was used for D7F7. This is inconsistent with the caption's blanket description of all comparisons being made against mIgG.
